lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother George, this is Mommy Pig and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa is waiting for her best friend, Susie Sheep.
lines.zh: 佩奇正在等她最好的朋友，小羊苏西。

lines.en: Hello Susie! Hello Peppa! Susie Sheep has come to play with Peppa.
lines.zh: 你好，苏西！你好，佩奇！小羊苏西来和佩奇一起玩了。

lines.en: Peppa loves Susie. Susie loves Peppa. They are best friends.
lines.zh: 佩奇喜欢苏西。苏西喜欢佩奇。她们是最好的朋友。

lines.en: Why don't you and Susie go and play in your bedroom? Yes, Mommy.
lines.zh: 你和苏西为什么不去你们的房间玩呢？好的，妈妈。

lines.en: George wants to play too.
lines.zh: 乔治也想玩。

lines.en: Peppa and Susie love playing in Peppa's bedroom. So does George.
lines.zh: 佩奇和苏西喜欢在佩奇的房间里玩。乔治也喜欢。

lines.en: No, George, this game is just for big girls.
lines.zh: 不行，乔治，这个游戏只给大女孩玩。

lines.en: Go and play with your own toys.
lines.zh: 去玩你自己的玩具吧。

lines.en: Peppa and Susie want to play on their own.
lines.zh: 佩奇和苏西想自己玩。

lines.en: I'm a tiny little fairy princess!
lines.zh: 我是一个小小的仙女公主！

lines.en: I'm going to wave my magic wand and turn you into a frog!
lines.zh: 我要挥动我的魔法棒，把你变成一只青蛙！

lines.en: George doesn't like playing on his own.
lines.zh: 乔治不喜欢自己一个人玩。

lines.en: George wants to play, too.
lines.zh: 乔治也想一起玩。

lines.en: George wants to play with Peppa. He feels a bit lonely.
lines.zh: 乔治想和佩奇一起玩。他觉得有点孤单。

lines.en: George, I need some help. I'm making chocolate chip cookies.
lines.zh: 乔治，我需要帮忙。我在做巧克力豆饼干。

lines.en: Someone needs to lick out the bowl.
lines.zh: 需要有人把碗舔干净。

lines.en: George likes helping Mummy make cookies, but he likes playing with Peppa more.
lines.zh: 乔治喜欢帮妈妈做饼干，但他更喜欢和佩奇一起玩。

lines.en: I want to be a nurse. I want to be a doctor.
lines.zh: 我想当护士。我想当医生。

lines.en: I'm going to be the sick person.
lines.zh: 我要当病人。

lines.en: Peppa and Susie love playing doctors and nurses. So does George.
lines.zh: 佩奇和苏西喜欢玩医生和护士的游戏。乔治也喜欢。

lines.en: Peppa listens to George's chest.
lines.zh: 佩奇听乔治的胸口。

lines.en: I think your heart's a bit loose. How about a plaster on it?
lines.zh: 我觉得你的心脏有点松。贴个创可贴怎么样？

lines.en: Open wide, please. Susie takes George's temperature.
lines.zh: 请把嘴张大。苏西给乔治量体温。

lines.en: Oh dear, you're very, very hot. I think you have to stay in bed for three years!
lines.zh: 哎呀，你烧得非常非常烫。我觉得你得在床上躺三年！

lines.en: Daddy Pig has come to find George. Oh no, what's wrong with George?
lines.zh: 猪爸爸来找乔治了。哦不，乔治怎么了？

lines.en: Don't worry, Daddy. It's only a game. George is our patient. Oh, I see.
lines.zh: 别担心，爸爸。这只是个游戏。乔治是我们的病人。哦，我明白了。

lines.en: Can the patient have a visitor?
lines.zh: 病人可以有访客吗？

lines.en: He might get tired.
lines.zh: 他可能会累的。

lines.en: They're for George, and his medicine to make him feel better.
lines.zh: 这是给乔治的，还有能让他好起来的药。

lines.en: Can you help me? I have a sore tummy. That tickles!
lines.zh: 你能帮帮我吗？我肚子疼。好痒啊！

lines.en: I think you're hungry, Daddy. Then I think I need lots of cookies to make me feel better. Thank you.
lines.zh: 我觉得你是饿了，爸爸。那我需要吃很多饼干才能好起来。谢谢。
